notes: Gullak's Careers link points to candid.hub.gullak.money/jobs/, a Candid SPA. It calls GET https://autohire.internal.svc.uat.glkmny.tech/public/jobs, which returns all 13 active pipelines in one unfiltered payload (id, name, description, experience_required, jd_link, status) and accepts no search/filter parameters. There is no search control or per-job detail page; the scraper takes the full response and filters locally.
